title: $t_0$: A Time-Series Foundation Model for Forecasting with Context
abstract: arXiv:2609.24559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present $t_0$, a family of open-weights foundation models for forecasting with multivariate context. We release its first two members: $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ and $\texttt{t0-beta}$, respectively 102M and 256M parameters. Both condition their forecasts on target history, past covariates, and known-future covariates, without task-specific retraining. Their transformer layers alternate attention along time and across variates. They produce probabilistic forecasts through quantile predictions. Pretraining combines curated public data with synthetic generator families constructed to contain covariate-to-target dependencies. On GIFT-Eval, $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ reaches an aggregate CRPS of 0.4941, and $\texttt{t0-beta}$ a CRPS of 0.4738 and a MASE of 0.6865, third on both and within 4.0% of the best zero-shot TSFM. translated_title: $t_0$：一个利用上下文进行预测的时间序列基础模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 $t_0$，一个用于多变量上下文预测的开源权重基础模型家族。我们发布了其前两个成员：t0-alpha 和 t0-beta，参数量分别为 1.02 亿和 2.56 亿。两者的预测均以目标历史、过去协变量和已知未来协变量为条件，无需针对特定任务进行重新训练。它们的 transformer 层在时间维度和变量维度上交替进行注意力计算，并通过分位数预测生成概率预测。预训练数据结合了精选的公开数据与专门构建的包含协变量到目标依赖关系的合成生成器家族。在 GIFT-Eval 基准上，t0-alpha 达到了 0.4941 的综合 CRPS，t0-beta 达到了 0.4738 的 CRPS 和 0.6865 的 MASE，两者均排名第三，与最佳零样本时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的差距在 4.0% 以内。在 fev-bench 上，两者的技能得分分别为 42.2 和 46.7，后者同样排名第三，落后领先者 2.0 分。我们分析了 t0-alpha……
tldr: 提出了开源权重时间序列基础模型家族 $t_0$，能够利用目标历史、过去协变量和已知未来协变量等多变量上下文进行零样本概率预测，在 GIFT-Eval 和 fev-bench 两大基准上均排名第三，性能接近最佳零样本模型。
en_tdlr: $t_0$ is a family of open-weights time-series foundation models that perform zero-shot probabilistic forecasting conditioned on multivariate context (target history, past covariates, and known-future covariates), ranking third on both GIFT-Eval and fev-bench benchmarks with performance within 4.0% of the best zero-shot TSFM.
